summary.text: Beverly Pingerelli is a member of the Arizona House of Representatives for District 28 and chairs the House Science and Technology Committee; her legislative page lists Peoria as her home city and 2021 as the year she became a member.

paragraphs.text: According to her legislative biography, she received a Bachelor of Science in Biological Sciences from Wayne State University in Detroit and trained as a cytogenetics technologist at Henry Ford Hospital.
The biography says she has worked in the Molecular Medicine Laboratory at St. Joseph's Hospital and served on the Peoria Unified Governing Board beginning in 2015, including as president in 2017.
